name: ml-pipeline
conclusion_quantitative: ml-pipeline (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 2 clarification rules, 6 approval gates, 1 validation rule; none for escalation rules. Strongest: approval gates.
conclusion_qualitative: ml-pipeline orchestrates ML tasks through product-manager, ML-engineer and SRE roles: formulating the task, extracting production data, analysing and modelling, and turning recommendations into a feature plan. Production access is read-only, and the user approves each stage, including every extraction command, before the next. It checks extracted data for completeness and sets no rules for escalating failures.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. All commands against production are read-only: no changes to production data or systems.

statements.quote: **⚠️ SAFETY: All commands are READ-ONLY. No mutations to production data or systems.**

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, all in running text. The agent gathers the ML task from the user and has the user confirm its summary of the project domain before going on.

statements.quote: Gather the ML task from the user:
Present the domain summary to the user for confirmation before proceeding.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 6 approval gates (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 6 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly running text. The user approves the task specification, reviews the data requirements and extraction plan, sees each extraction command before it runs, and approves the recommendations before a feature plan is generated.

statements.quote: Present to user for approval. Adjust based on feedback.
Present the data requirements and extraction plan to the user for review.
Show the exact command/query to the user before execution
Present recommendations to the user. Wait for approval before proceeding.
After user approves the recommendations, invoke `/feature-plan` with the following input:

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. After each extraction the agent verifies the data is complete: row counts, date ranges and null percentages.

statements.quote: Verify data completeness — row counts, date ranges, null percentages

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
